QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_46

question.text: A Cat III AIF launching a NEW SCHEME must:

answer.text: File PPM with SEBI within 30 days prior to launch along with scheme fees
File PPM with SEBI within 60 days post-launch
Obtain unanimous LP consent from existing schemes

explanation.text: The Logic: The PPM of a new scheme must be filed with SEBI within 30 days prior to launch of the new scheme, along with scheme fees. The pre-launch filing-plus-fee requirement does not apply to Large Value Funds floated for Accredited Investors (LVF-AI). The Trap: 60-day post-launch (B) reverses the timing. Unanimous LP consent (C) is not a requirement. RBI pre-clearance (D) confuses the scheme launch with FEMA processes. Note: The pre-launch PPM-filing-and-scheme-fee rule, and the LVF-AI exception, are covered in the workbook on pp. 235 and 349.
